title: The runbook says whether a provisional answer can be confirmed by a delegate
goal: A provisional answer can be confirmed by a named delegate: `backlog.py answer ID GATE --confirm --by delegate:NAME` is accepted only while an operator grant names NAME (a grant the operator writes in the backlog, such as a `delegates` list on the sprint item that only `--by operator` can set), and is recorded as that delegate; without a grant, or for a gate of a class only the operator answers, it is refused as today. kb/_self/backlog.md states the rule. Planted tests: a granted delegate confirms, an ungranted one and a grant written by an agent are refused. Answers the SP-xdzgepun review, where a delegated confirmation was asked for with no rule to follow.
